key_terms.مُسْتَبْشِرَةٌ: Full of joy or expecting good news

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Dahikatun Mustabsirah' mean in the context of Surah Abasa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase characterizes the demeanor of the one who turned away from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) upon his frowning, often interpreted as a sign of eager anticipation or pleased acceptance of the rebuke. It highlights the dynamic between the Prophet's gentle correction and the recipient's receptive, cheerful disposition, underscoring the virtue of humility in receiving guidance.
